    Around the shop

    The shop

    Two brothers, one standard.

    The sign band still says it in gold script — Established 1979. Regulars from the shop's earliest era measured their loyalty in decades, and plenty of today's customers are the kids and grandkids of the first ones.

    Brothers Greg and Joe Landwehr have run the shop since the late '90s. Nothing about the place is fancy; everything about it is earned — including the readers'-choice hardware on the wall.

    Same building. Same family. Same standard.

    Weekends, they go a little faster

    Your mechanics are national champions.

    Greg and Joe crew on Team Mac Attack — a nitro-burning nostalgia Funny Car driven by NHRA legend Cory "Mac" McClenathan. Greg builds and services the clutch. Joe mixes the fuel. In April 2023 the team won the NHRA Winternationals — its first national title.

    If they can keep a nitro Funny Car alive, your Subaru is in good hands.
